crossrefs.text: A wife of noble character, who can find? She is far more precious than rubies.
Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.
Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.
In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

You have searched all my goods! Have you found anything that belongs to you? Put it here before my brothers and yours, that they may judge between the two of us. I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten the rams of your flock.

But he refused. “Look,” he said to his masterʼs wife, “with me here, my master does not concern himself with anything in his house, and he has entrusted everything he owns to my care. No one in this house is greater than I am. He has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?”
Ahimelech answered the king, “Who among all your servants is as faithful as David, the kingʼs son-in-law, the captain of your bodyguard and honored in your house?
May the LORD repay every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. For the Lorddelivered you into my hand today, but I would not extend my hand against the LORDʼs anointed.
who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances.
how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!
Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
For we are Godʼs workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
